major.name: Drowned Organ
major.perks: Primary: Mending-Weapons +20% Damage wenn Hull <60%. Secondary: Mending-Weapons +1% Sec-Damage pro 1% Hull-Missing max 30%. Tertiary: +1% Max-Hull pro Mending-Weapon.
major.synergy: Mending-Weapons (Soulsnatcher, Atma's Toll). Top-Major fuer Sustain-Builds, die niedrige Hull-Health aktiv halten.

major.name: Royal Ramming Works
major.perks: Primary: Ram baut 50% Punctured + -20% Speed 20s auf. Secondary: Punctured-Targets nehmen +15% Piercing-Damage. Tertiary: Targets <250m +7% Punctured-Aufbau.
major.synergy: Brigantine-Bullhorn (Ram-Boost), Hullcarver (+100% Weakpoint mit Piercing III), Needle-Shield (Bracing-Bonus auf Punctured).

major.name: Floodwarden Station
major.perks: Konsekutive Hits +2% Flooding-Charges & +2% Damage max 20% (Fehlschuss = Reset). +10% Damage von Flooded-Gegnern. Flooded-Dauer +10%.
major.synergy: Flooding-Builds mit Carronade/Endless Requiem/Rahma's Legacy. Alternative zu Drowned Organ wenn kein Mending-Weapon equipped.

major.name: Hull Marker's Table
major.perks: Primary: Broadside-Treffer 5% Chance auf 'Impact Mark' = +20% Cannonball-Damage 20s. Secondary: Pro Cannonball-Weapon +5% Sec-Damage.

major.name: Megaphone
major.synergy: Reload-Speed-Builds. Solid Default-Major bevor Build-spezifische Synergie verfuegbar.

major.name: Ramrod Workshop
major.synergy: Long-Cannon-Builds mit langen Reload-Zeiten (Divine Thunder 7.2s, Lange Kartouwe 7.2s).

major.name: Iron Capstan
major.perks: Reduziert Damage um 15% und +100% Threat Generation während Anchored.
major.synergy: Frigate-Tank-Builds mit Anchor-Brawl-Spielweise. Threat-Generation hält Aggro auf der tankenden Frigate.

major.name: Gunner's Quadrant
major.perks: -15% Reload-Time für die gleiche Waffe nach Weakpoint-Hit aus ≥160m Range, 10s.
major.synergy: Long-Range-Builds (Frigate Punctured Piercing, Brigantine Long Cannons) — synergisiert mit Hullcarver-Weakpoint-Damage.

major.name: Wyrm's Breath Churner
major.perks: Shell-Shocked-Trigger: +20% Reload-Time auf Target 10s. +20% Sekundär-Damage von Explosive-Weapons. +Explosive-Weapon-Damage.

major.name: Scoping Station
major.perks: Treffer >320m applizieren Marked-Status. Marked-Targets nehmen +100% Weakpoint-Damage.

minor.name: Long Gun Grinder
minor.effect: Spezifischer Long-Gun-Reload- oder Damage-Buff. Synergie mit Divine Thunder / Lange Kartouwe.

minor.name: Front Powder Kegs
minor.effect: Damage-Buff fuer Bow-Slot-Weapons. Synergie mit Hullcarver / Divine Thunder Bow.

minor.name: Mortar Powderbench
minor.effect: Mortar-Reload- oder Speed-Buff. Synergie mit Eye of Heaven / Leopold.

minor.name: The Termites
minor.effect: Structure-Damage-Buff. Synergie mit Padewakang Detonate fuer Fort-Builds.
